captionStarter: Oregon 41, USC 27. Ducks win it on the road in the rivalry.
concept: Quick hit: USC's preseason swagger vs. the scoreboard after the Coliseum lights came on

headline: No. 20 Oregon topples No. 12 USC 41-27 in LA
